content:
maria: Quick idea: expose per-route sampling + a small redaction-confidence badge in the Console. Make debug samples easier to find without widening PII exposure.

sam: do you want separate debug vs audit streams or one stream with tags?

maria: one stream, two tags. debug=ephemeral (24h view-only), audit=rare + stricter access + longer retention.

devon: default debug_rate should be tiny (0.05%?). per-route override allowed. ops needs a org-level cap.
lisa: how do we generate "redaction-confidence"? ML score or heuristic? showing raw score might be misleading.
maria: plan: store redaction_mode, confidence (0.0-1.0), and a short reason label (e.g., "email", "ssn-like"). UI shows confidence but never auto-bypasses scrub.

patrick: attachments/embeddings are high risk. default: no sampling for routes that accept files or embeddings; require explicit tenant opt-in.

infra-bot: policy-alert: route /v1/upload flagged high sensitivity (sensitivity=0.93).

maria: OK enforce auto-opt-out for file routes. text-only routes get conservative defaults.
sam: can you paste a proposed config snippet? helps infra + product align.

maria: example config:

```yaml
route: /v1/completions
sampling:
  debug_rate: 0.0005   # 0.05% debug visible in Console
  audit_rate: 0.00002  # 0.002% to audit store
redaction:
  mode: mask-first   # options: mask-first | token-hash | redact-all
  confidence_threshold: 0.9
  attachments: deny_by_default
```

devon: Console UX: show "sampling: 0.05% debug / 0.002% audit" inline and a help pop explaining what each sample contains. add a small histogram for redaction_confidence over time.
lisa: compliance ask: viewing debug samples should require breakglass justification + audit log. TTL 24h sounds right.
maria: agreed breakglass justification + actor stored. debug view expires after 24h; audit samples retained per customer retention policy.

patrick: incident scenario: need immediate global kill-switch to set all debug_rate=0. Also surface banner when kill-switch active.
sam: we'll add global flag with higher priority than per-route; show banner and require infra team approval to re-enable.
devon: cost calc: Console should estimate token-cost delta when a user adjusts slider (projected monthly cost).
maria: good call. include recent volume * avg tokens * sampling -> cost delta.
lisa: one more: tie sampled examples into Redwood Optimize evals so we detect regressions where redaction fails or over-scrubs. alert on spike in false-negative/positive rates.
maria: next steps: I'll write a short RFC + prototype PR for the API and minimal Console UI. owner: @devon. please add compliance caveats and a list of auto-opt-out route patterns.
sam: :thumbsup: also list routes that are explicit opt-in and how tenants request it.
devon: will coordinate with infra to wire the kill-switch + quota cap endpoints. I'll post links once PRs open.
maria: thanks all will drop RFC link here when ready. :eyes:
